steps.content: Hella races out of the elevated lab and sprints downward, running straight into a dust-covered Horo who has just emerged from underground.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella! Why are you coming out of the lab?! That bunch of...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know! We'll deal with them later... Whoa!
Another violent tremor shakes the ground, and a massive rift opens beneath Hella's feet. Horo grabs her from behind and pulls her back in time so she can regain her footing.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Furor's defenses won't hold much longer. We can't risk losing the entire Legion here. We should retreat for now.
Horo starts to walk away, but Hella grabs her arm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait! Before we leave, there's something more important...!
